summary: Expion Energy, Inc. (formerly Expion360 Inc.) filed an 8-K regarding a private placement of $9M aggregate principal 8% convertible debentures due 2029, plus warrants for 2,117,219 common shares, to purchasers including lead investor Five Narrow Lane LP, affiliated with former CEO Joseph Hammer. The debentures convert into Series A-1 preferred stock, subject to shareholder approval, then into common shares. Proceeds appear intended for corporate purposes, not explicitly a shareholder return. No specific capital return mechanism (dividend, buyback) is stated. The deal is a financing, not a return of capital, so classification is tentative.
